root_cause: High error rate on order-gateway is linked to the recent change CHG-4471 on reference-db which limits max_connections and causes rejected connection warnings. No direct logs confirm this change is the cause on order-gateway. Rollback is suspected but not confirmed.
summary: Escalated to on-call: The investigator confirmed the cause is the recent change CHG-4471 on reference-db limiting max connections and causing order-gateway errors. No immediate mitigation action is proposed due to lack of log confirmation for rollback, but this condition affects a critical dependency. Escalation is needed for higher-level troubleshooting and potential rollback authorization.
